about: A time-lapse over a settlement rising in its forest clearing by a lake (D381), in one continuous establishing pull-out with no handheld drift: it opens about 40 degrees down onto the first house from 22 m off and 18 m up as its walls go up, then pulls straight back south-south-west, from rest and still moving at the end, while the settlement spreads to the whole market town. The distance grows throughout, the pitch flattens to 8 degrees down so the mountains come onto the skyline, and the camera never rises past 40 m over the meadow; the lens widens from 20 to 15.5 mm (settlement r25, after the developer: no shake, start angled, zoom out progressively, more horizontal, not crazy high).
